title: Round buttons sized down · Resume's own sheet

steps.path: Any tag with a round × or + (Session details, session list…)
steps.headline: The round × and + are smaller, so each leaves a margin of pill above and below it.
steps.changed: Three sizes, one per pill size: 10 px in the small list pills, 12 px in Session details' other tags, 16 px on this session's tags.
steps.measured: 2-4 px of pill now shows above and below each button
steps.notice: The buttons no longer crowd the pill's edge.
steps.risk: A smaller button is a slightly smaller target to click.

steps.path: Resume → the tag icon on a conversation
steps.headline: Which sheet fits Resume's narrow panel best?
steps.notice: All three drop the big cards-in-a-card of Session details. The note shows quoted, or "+ Add a note", without hanging into the margin. Same tags and Pin to top underneath. The side panel and Projects preview would get your pick too.
steps.risk: Session details itself (the status bar popup) is unchanged.

variants.label: Flat
variants.summary: No inner cards: "Note" and "Tags" labels, then everything laid flat in the Resume card.

variants.label: Add on demand
variants.summary: The note, this session's tags and a "+ Add tag" pill; the search and other tags appear only when you press it. Shortest.
variants.risk: One more click to add a tag.

variants.label: One card
variants.summary: Note, tags and Pin together in a single inset card.
variants.risk: Still a card inside the Resume card.
